{{Quote|Well. There's one Child of the Emperor who doesn't go for subtlety.|[[Tharan Cedrax]]|<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|[[Kira Carsen's ship]]}}</ref>}}
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''S. Geland''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that was the [[Warden/Legends|chief warden]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[The Tomb]]; but he secretly was also one of the [[Children of the Emperor]] and he tried many times to stop the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] when he arrived on his prison. Finally, he directly confronted the Barsen'thor and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] allies together with two [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] but the Barsen'thor [[Death/Legends|killed]] him at last. During the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|final confrontation]] with [[Tenebrae]], Geland was among the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] that were summoned and witnessed his final death. After the Emperor's death, Geland found peace and became one with the Force.<ref name="Echoes" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geland is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
